**Newsletter: Repair Cafe Accepting Bicycle Wheels on June 3**

Dear Readers,

We're excited to announce that the Repair Cafe will be accepting bicycle wheels on June 3! To book your slot, please visit our website and select the "Bicycle Wheels" option.

This event is a great opportunity for those who want to learn how to fix bicycles or for those who just want to get their wheels fixed. Don't miss out on this chance to make your bicycle wheels last longer!

Stay tuned for more updates and remember to book your slot today.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
